title: Shiv Shivakumar (ex-CEO PepsiCo India, Nokia India, Aditya Birla) — 'This is a great book from Eric Ries on why companies go bad'
summary: Shiv Shivakumar — one of India Inc's longest-serving CEOs (twenty-year run across Nokia India, PepsiCo India, and Aditya Birla Group; currently operating partner at Advent International; author of The Right Choice, The Art of Management, and The CEO Mindset) — publishes a 97-like LinkedIn endorsement of Incorruptible, calling out greed, financial gravity, and board ineffectiveness as the wrong things Ries names.
blockquote: This is a great book from Eric Ries on why companies go bad. He has many examples of companies doing the right thing and also succumbing to the wrong things. The wrong things invariably are greed, financial gravity, board ineffectiveness etc.
attribution_title: Operating Partner, Advent International; former CEO PepsiCo India, Nokia India, Aditya Birla Group
